spot.en: It is definitely hairy skin and Anand was spot on.
spot.zh: It is definitely hairy skin and Anand was spot on.

spectacular.en: And in some cases, this has resulted in some spectacular U-turns .
spectacular.zh: 在某些情况下，这导致了一些令人惊叹的“大转向”。

spiral.en: Sure, once you get a plant up and running, it's cheap to run, but the build of it is incredibly expensive, and costs almost always overrun , or perhaps spiral out of control would be a better way of putting it.
spiral.zh: 诚然，一旦电站建成并投入运营，其运行成本就很低，但建造费用极其昂贵，而且成本几乎总是超支，或者说失去控制可能更贴切。

split.en: And there is also the promise, or at least the allure , of nuclear fusion, the other kind of nuclear power, the one that works by fusing atoms together rather than splitting them apart.
split.zh: 此外，还有核聚变的前景，或者至少说是其吸引力，那是另一种核电，其原理是通过将原子聚变在一起而不是将它们分裂开来。

spice.en: British Christmas food, like mince pies, are full of spices like nutmeg, cinnamon, mace.
spice.zh: 英国的圣诞食物，比如肉馅饼，充满了肉豆蔻、肉桂、肉豆蔻衣等香料。

spice.en: Black pudding is a traditional spiced blood sausage and part of a traditional breakfast.
spice.zh: 黑布丁是一种传统的加香料的血肠，也是传统早餐的一部分。

spread.en: Supermarkets started to spread to every town.
spread.zh: 超市开始普及到每一个城镇。
